questions.text: How many times did you do formal meditation practice in the past week?
questions.section: Questions 1 to 6 ask about your formal meditation practice (e.g. sitting meditation).

questions.text: What was the average duration of each meditation session?
When meditating, how much of the time was your attention focused on what you intended to focus on (body, breath, sounds etc.)?
When meditating, how much of the time were you noticing when you were getting distracted?
When meditating, how much of the time were you practicing an accepting attitude toward what you were experiencing?
When meditating, how much of the time were you practicing being gentle and compassionate toward yourself?
In your daily life, how much of the time were you practicing paying attention to everyday activities (e.g. eating, walking, chores, communicating etc.)?
questions.section: Questions 7 to 12 ask about your informal practice (being mindful in everyday life, outside of meditation sessions).

questions.text: In your daily life, how much of the time were you practicing paying attention while working or studying?
In your daily life, how much of the time were you practicing bringing your attention back to what you were doing when it wandered off?
In your daily life, how much of the time were you practicing being aware of your thoughts, emotions and reactions?
In your daily life, how much of the time were you practicing bringing an accepting attitude toward what you were experiencing?
In your daily life, how much of the time were you practicing being gentle and compassionate toward yourself?
How are you feeling this week?
What has been your experience with the mindfulness practice this week?
